data.name: Iksir
data.gender_notes: Iksir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic and Arabic culture, the name Iksir is derived from the word 'iksir' meaning 'magic' or 'elixir'. This powerful and mystical name is mentioned in various Islamic hadiths and is believed to bring protection and blessings to the bearer. The name Iksir carries the meaning “Magic, Elixir” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iksir usually hope their child will grow to embody magic, elixir and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with divine magic and blessings.
data.etymology: Iksir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Magic, Elixir.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iksir total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إكسير
in_arabic.meaning: إكسير هو اسم يعني أصل الشيء و جوهره و خلاصته
in_arabic.long_meaning: إكسير هو اسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية 'كسير' و تعني أصل الشيء و جوهره و خلاصته. في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية، يعتبر الإكسير كلمة تشير إلى الخليط أو الدواء الذي يجعل الحياة أطول أو يعزز الصحة. و في بعض الأحيان، يرتبط الإكسير بالبحث عن الخلود أو الشباب الدائم.

in_urdu.name: ایکسیر
in_urdu.meaning: ایکسیر کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کی اصل اور خلاصہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایکسیر ایک عربی لفظ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کی اصل اور خلاصہ. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص معانی رکھتا ہے، جیسے کہ دواء یا ایسی چیز جو زندگی کو بہتر بناتی ہے. ایكسير کے معنی فارسی اور عربی لغتوں میں مختلف ہیں، لیکن عموماً یہ لفظ کچھ ایسی چیز کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو بہت قیمتی اور طاقتور ہوتی ہے.

in_hindi.name: इक्सीर
in_hindi.meaning: इक्सीर का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का मूल और सार
in_hindi.long_meaning: इक्सीर एक अरबी शब्द से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का मूल और सार. इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में विशेष अर्थों के साथ किया जाता है, जैसे कि एक ऐसा पदार्थ जो जीवन को बेहतर बनाता है या स्वास्थ्य को बढ़ावा देता है. यह नाम हिंदू और मुस्लिम समुदायों में समान रूप से प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: ایکسر
in_pashto.meaning: ایکسر د شیانو د اصلي او خالص مطلب
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایکسر د عربي کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د شیانو د اصلي او خالص مطلب دی. دا نوم په ځینو اسلامي کلتورونو کې داسې شیانو ته اشاره کوي لکه دوا یا هغه څه چې ژوند ته وده ورکوي. په پښتو کې، ایكسير یو نوم دی چې د ځانګړي اهمیت سره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Iksir
in_english.meaning: Iksir means the essence, origin, or quintessence of something
in_english.long_meaning: Iksir is derived from the Arabic language, signifying the essence, origin, or quintessence of something. In Islamic tradition, Iksir is associated with a mythical substance or elixir that grants eternal life, health, or spiritual enlightenment. The term has historical significance in alchemy and Sufism, representing the pursuit of spiritual growth and self-discovery.

historical_references.reference: Iksir was a legendary elixir of life, said to grant eternal youth and vitality to those who consumed it. It was first mentioned in the works of Ibn Sina (Avicenna) in the 11th century AD. Ibn Sina described Iksir as a complex mixture of various ingredients, including myrrh, cinnamon, ginger, and pearl powder.
historical_references.context: Ibn Sina's works on medicine and alchemy

historical_references.reference: The use of Iksir as an elixir of life was also mentioned in later Islamic literature, particularly in the works of Ibn Arabi in the 13th century AD. Ibn Arabi described Iksir as a divine substance that could be accessed through spiritual practices and meditation, rather than through physical consumption.
historical_references.context: Ibn Arabi's works on spirituality and mysticism

modern_usage.modern_context: Iksir, an Arabic term meaning 'elixir' or 'antidote', has gained popularity in modern contexts across various industries. In the pharmaceutical industry, Iksir is used to refer to traditional Arabic medicines that are gaining recognition for their efficacy and unique formulations. On e-commerce platforms like Amazon and Alibaba, consumers can purchase a wide range of Iksir-labeled products, including herbal remedies and various health supplements. In the cosmetics sector, Iksir is embraced as a brand name for luxury skincare products inspired by ancient Arabic recipes, with Sephora being a major retailer. The general trend reflects the growing interest in the rich cultural heritage of the Arab world and the belief that traditional knowledge can offer modern solutions to health and wellness concerns.
